data.label: Homepage Checklist
data.title:
Your website homepage is
*losing you money*
data.sub: Swipe to see what you're missing →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: A clear *value proposition*
data.body: Your customers need to know exactly what you do within three seconds. If they have to guess, they will leave.
data.fix: Fix: State your service and city in the main headline.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: A *clickable* phone number
data.body: When a customer has an emergency, they want to call you immediately. Make it easy for them to reach you.
data.fix: Fix: Add a button that dials your number when tapped.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: An *obvious* call to action
data.body: Don't make visitors hunt for how to hire you. Give them one clear next step to start the process.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Get a Quote' button near the top.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Professional *real photos*
data.body: Stock photos look fake and build no trust. Show your actual team or finished projects to prove you are legit.
data.fix: Fix: Replace generic photos with shots of your own work.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Social *proof elements*
data.body: People trust other customers more than they trust you. Show them you are reliable right away.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 5-star rating or one short client quote.
